review_text_raw:
I am stupid. I love the simulacra series I really do, I saw it had bad reviews and I though eh they are normally reviewed pretty badly but it scratched an itch that no other games do. But what the f*** was that. That was not a simulacra game. That was a mess of cheap horror. [spoiler] Like wtf was the 3D model of the Beldam, why was she shiny!?! The death scenes of characters, seeing the goofy ah face of the Beldam. It looked awful.  And why did I become the security guard from while looking at Pauls house?! Like springtrap luring s***[/spoiler]

I didnt feel any tension at all during the game , nor did I care about the characters. Like they could die and I would feel fine. [spoiler] I suppose they could of and Paul did, but I'm such an epic gamer and saved everyone in an 'tense' battle against the simulacra, by giving Ruby moral support. I didnt even get to talk to the simulacra :(. I guess I learnt if my friends get possessed I will tell them to have a cup of tea and have a hot bath. [/spoiler]

The game also never  caught my attention, half the time I just got my 3DS out and started playing my silly little fashion game while I listen to those damn tapes. It was boring. 

I honestly have wasted my money. I have learnt my lesson I suppose. I will now sulk about this for a few weeks while I reminisce about the money that used to be in my bank.
